literal: Their own strength not knowing, by mere enthusiasm spurred on, in the middle broke down many.
translation: Many are those who, not knowing the measure of their own strength, are spurred on by mere enthusiasm and break down midway.
modern: தங்கள் சொந்த வலிமையை அறியாமல், வெறும் ஆர்வத்தினால் மட்டும் தூண்டப்பட்டுச் செயலில் இறங்கி, வழியிலேயே அழிந்துபோனவர்கள் பலர்.
explanation: This couplet warns against starting an enterprise based solely on passion without assessing one's actual capability. 'உடைத்தம் வலி' refers to one's own strength or resources, which must be measured realistically. 'ஊக்கம்' means zeal or enthusiasm, which is a powerful motivator but dangerous when blind. Those who act out of mere excitement without self-evaluation are described as 'இடைக்கண் முரிந்தார்'—they break down and fail halfway through their journey.
